baseline.note: P00 measured a captured source at one commit, not a closure of the current tree, so the manifest holds the identity P00 recorded and this resolver reproduces its fingerprint rather than measuring a second answer.

contracts.note: P01 owns workenv/contracts/, which holds the record dispatch and every schema document; the package's own __init__ is declared because no node owns it and every importer of the dispatch reaches it.

full-runtime.note: every node P18 reaches through depends_on, so the bundle moves when any part it verifies moves; the set is read from the plan rather than listed here, because the plan owns what P18 depends on.

operations-runtime.note: every node M3 reaches through depends_on, so the bundle moves when any part it verifies moves; the set is read from the plan rather than listed here, because the plan owns what M3 depends on.

package.note: the payload is what package.json files[] names, so the manifest names the file that owns the list instead of copying it; a path added to files[] joins this closure without an edit here.

except.provenance.json: gates/check-publish.sh --stamp writes it into the tarball at pack time, so it is never in the tree to measure

personal-runtime.note: every node M1 reaches through depends_on, so the bundle moves when any part it verifies moves; the set is read from the plan rather than listed here, because the plan owns what M1 depends on.

runner.note: a runner is a set of tool and host identities, not repository bytes. A resolver over tracked paths cannot measure it, and answering with a digest of something else would be worse than answering unknown.

team-runtime.note: every node M2 reaches through depends_on, so the bundle moves when any part it verifies moves; the set is read from the plan rather than listed here, because the plan owns what M2 depends on.
